 Match Preview
 Major League Soccer - 1/8 21 Nov 2026 - 11:00 Gillette Stadium New England Revolution host Philadelphia Union at Gillette Stadium in Foxborough in a Major League Soccer playoff fixture, with both Eastern Conference sides looking to advance.
 Marko Mitrovic's Revolution come into this game having lost two of their last three matches, with back-to-back defeats to Orlando City and Inter Miami denting their momentum at a critical stage of the season.
 Philadelphia Union arrive under Ryan Richter in decent shape by comparison. The Union beat Toronto FC 4-1 in their most recent outing, though they have been inconsistent, picking up just one win from their previous four before that result.
 The head-to-head record adds another layer of intrigue. New England won the last meeting between these sides in October, a 2-1 victory at Philadelphia, and they have taken four of the last five encounters.
 Gillette Stadium should provide a charged atmosphere for what is a straight knockout contest, with no margin for error on either side.
